svg.title: The different types of lighting in UE5
svg.desc: Recreated course slide explaining built lighting and dynamic lighting.

g.text: In software like Unreal Engine, you can build lighting or you can keep lighting dynamic.
When you build lighting, the computer is going to basically pre render all of your lights.
This can save performance because the light is not recalculating all of that data
frame by frame, and it can also be rendered in with higher quality.
Dynamic lighting recalculates rendering and shadow data around it
